Create a clean orthographic armored fit-check sheet using the attached references.

Image A is the exact MetaHuman body reference.
Image B is the approved armor-on-body design reference.

Show the MetaHuman wearing the approved armor in four full-body orthographic views: FRONT, LEFT, BACK, and RIGHT. Preserve the exact same body proportions from Image A. The armor must fit this body correctly and consistently in every view.

The armor should match the approved design from Image B exactly in materials, details, motifs, silhouette, thickness, and construction. Keep the character’s identity and body shape consistent. Do not make the body more heroic, broader, taller, or more muscular.

Presentation requirements:
- square or portrait sheet
- clean neutral background, flat and uniform
- no cinematic environment
- no shadows
- soft even studio lighting
- full body visible and uncropped
- consistent scale across all four views
- orthographic projection
- small simple labels only: FRONT, LEFT, BACK, RIGHT
- no decorative poster text

The purpose of this image is technical review: to verify that the armor design actually fits the MetaHuman in front, side, and back views before generating isolated assets.
